verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is explicitly promoted as a CI/CD platform ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD') and GitHub ships an official CLI (gh) that can be scripted/run headlessly in automation pipelines, supporting the general story of running GitHub headlessly in CI. However, evidence doesn't detail how AI-native/Copilot capabilities specifically integrate into headless CI workflows (e.g., invoking Copilot or agent tasks non-interactively from Actions), so the AI-native automation angle is thin. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of invoking Copilot/agent features headlessly within CI/Actions workflows, and independent hands-on confirmation of automation reliability.
